To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
SiLo is a scalable and efficient data deduplication system.

SiLo achieves a 2.3X improvement of duplicate elimination efficiency, a 2.5X increase of deduplication throughput (from 2.5GB/s to 6.3GB/s), a 3.2X reduction of memory usage, and a 1.5X reduction of CPU usage compared to the state-of-the-art deduplication system.
SiLo can achieve near-exact duplicate elimination, high deduplication performance, and good load balancing among backup nodes at extremely low RAM cost.
